scope: Native JSON-valued class API hosting; separate from the runpod-python symbol inventory
verified_contracts: Initialization completes before HTTP acceptance and healthy ping
GET forwards no arguments; other verbs forward one non-null JSON body or no arguments
Query and path parameters are not forwarded
Native handler errors return HTTP 500; returned error keys remain ordinary data
Handler-name route ordering, method precedence, path converters, and slash redirects
OpenAPI output and framework documentation-route precedence
Actual SDK client calls against the native HTTP host
native_adaptations: Closure-owned state replaces Python class construction and method binding
Owned registries and typed Rust errors replace interpreter globals and exceptions
Synchronous functions use the blocking executor; native streams collect into JSON arrays
Explicit listener/shutdown ownership replaces Uvicorn process management
JSON values use serde_json numeric and Unicode domains
pending_contracts: Arbitrary response body/status/header support for native API methods
Native framework factories corresponding to ASGI factories
Live dispatcher source synchronization and execution
Native binary artifact loading and manifest-based resource selection
Automatic runtime mount initialization before native application loading
